title: Confirm before deleting attachments from an unfiltered Doc. Attachment List Factbox
summary: A confirmation dialog now prevents accidental bulk deletion of attachments when the Doc. Attachment List Factbox loads without its filters due to a platform defect, protecting attachments from other documents.
key_points: Adds OnDeleteRecord confirmation that triggers only when the factbox is completely unfiltered
Stores selected record SystemIds in a list to confirm only on the first record of a bulk delete operation
Unfiltered state is detected by checking all filter groups (0-255) for absence of filters
Confirmation defaults to No, requiring explicit user approval to delete from an unfiltered list
Normal filtered delete behavior and GuiAllowed false scenarios remain unchanged
